Subject: Important Notice: Academic Year 2026–27 Tuition Rates

Dear BPI Families,

We are writing to inform you of an important update regarding tuition for the upcoming Academic Year 2026–27. Effective August 1, 2026, tuition rates will reflect a 4% adjustment to support our continued investment in staff, programming, and facilities at both the NMZ and Wesson campuses.

Updated rate schedules for all programs will be posted by June 1, 2026. Families currently enrolled in a payment plan arrangement will receive a separate, individualized notice with updated payment terms no later than June 15.

If you have questions or would like to speak with someone from the Business Office, please reach out to us at businessoffice@bpi.edu. We are happy to assist.

Thank you for your continued partnership with BPI.

— Dylan Sheen, Business Manager · Brilliant Preparatory Institute
